newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 25.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 25.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones rose 76.58 points to 7,008.20. PLDT's ADR was unchanged at $60.
* The peso closed rose to 26.340 to a U.S. dollar vs 26.343
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index rose 36.69 points to 3,338.67.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average inched up to 10.5625 pct vs 10.53125 pct.
* Negros Navigation Co says it will enter into a joint venture agreement with Mabuhay Holdings Corp and Sembawang Maritime Ltd of Singapore to operate a fast ferry service.
* Swift Foods Inc reports a loss of 200 million pesos for the period July to December, down from a net income of 126 million in the same period the previous fiscal year.
* Gotesco land Inc will seek approval from the Philippine Stock Exhange the right to offer an estimated 2.6 billion pesos worth of shares to fund its resort projects. (PHILIPPINE DAILY INQUIRER)
* Petron cornered the lion's share of the 43.1 percent of the market in January this year, the energy department says.
* Belle Corp will pursue the increase of its capital base to 20 billion pesos from the present 4.0 billion pesos.
